item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find direct 2024 evidence that Khamenei used emergency dashboards, disaster audits, epidemiological data, or public correction loops to reduce suffering. I also did not find a clear 2024 case of Khamenei leading a major, documented relief effort for famine, pandemic, or disaster displacement.
